newsitem.title: USA: FSA has insurance capacity for Puerto Rico debt.
newsitem.headline: FSA has insurance capacity for Puerto Rico debt.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said Tuesday it has secondary market insurance capacity for Commonwealth of Puerto Rico and Puerto Rico Public Building Authority debt.
Capacity is limited to $7.5 million per firm Tuesday on a first-come, first-served basis. After Tuesday, remaining capacity will be available without limit per firm.
Insurance is available in maturities 2003 and longer only, FSA said. Insurance is limited on maturities longer than 2010.
For more information, call Tom Byrne, Greg Haggerty or Alan Steinfeld at 212-826-0601.
